subject: Vendor payment orientation & remittance-field encoding
body:
From: Alina Soto <alina.soto@sagewave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor payment orientation & remittance-field encoding

Hi Ben —

Thanks for taking this onboarding call yesterday. As discussed, I’m attaching SageWave’s bank letter and a sample remittance CSV so your payments team can validate field mapping for POs/invoice references. We primarily pay via ACH (same-day ACH where possible); wire is used for expedited/thresholded payments.

Quick notes from our side:
- PO#/SageWave invoice reference should appear in the remittance file as the field named "invoice_reference" (we sometimes prefix with "PO-" on our side).
- Our accounting team requires the remitter name and PO on the first line of remittance when a single payment covers multiple invoices.
- W-9 and bank letter attached.

Attachments: SageWave_BankLetter_20270506.pdf (bank letter, PDF), sagemap_remit_sample.csv (CSV)

Can you confirm Redwood’s expected CSV schema (field names and max lengths) and whether the platform accepts "invoice_reference" as the remittance key? If you prefer, I can re-export with PO#, invoice# and our internal reference separated into three distinct columns.

Thanks —
Alina Soto
Director, Finance Operations
SageWave Logistics
alina.soto@sagewave.com
(415) 555-0182

----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alina Soto <alina.soto@sagewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor payment orientation & remittance-field encoding

Hi Alina —

Appreciate the docs and sample CSV. Attaching our internal payments checklist for vendor onboarding and a quick mapping table below. High-level: Redwood’s payflow imports a CSV that can contain an "invoice_reference" field — that will map to the PO or invoice id used for reconciliation. A few validation points so we don’t hit edge cases when your first payouts come through: 

Required fields we expect from external remits (preferred order):
- remitter_name (string, 128 chars)
- amount (decimal, two decimals)
- currency (3-letter code)
- invoice_reference (string, 64 chars) -> maps to PO/invoice id in our ledger
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- supplier_bank_account_last4 (string, 4 chars) (optional but helpful)

Questions for you:
1) Do you want the PO to live only in "invoice_reference" or do you want a separate "po_number" column? Either works; if you use the single "invoice_reference" field please avoid additional prefixes beyond "PO-" unless required — that will help our reconciliation regex.
2) For multi-invoice payments, do you provide a single CSV row with a pipe-separated list in "invoice_reference" or multiple rows per invoice? We can support either but need to validate preferred approach.

If you confirm the CSV layout (and whether you’ll use pipe-separated invoice lists), I’ll pass to Payments (Marissa) for a preflight import test in our UAT environment and coordinate one test ACH micro-deposit / import before first live run.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marco Diaz <mdiaz@payments.sagewave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alina Soto <alina.soto@sagewave.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor payment orientation & remittance-field encoding

Ben —

Attaching the export you requested (sagemap_remit_sample.csv). We’ll use: po_number, invoice_number, invoice_amount, invoice_date and invoice_reference. For your reconciliation we can populate invoice_reference with the PO (no prefix), and keep a separate po_number column if you prefer. For multi-invoice payments we usually send one CSV line per invoice and then a payment batch id column on the payment header.

ACH is preferred for day-to-day. We’ll only send wires for manual exceptions (rush payments). Are there any character-set restrictions on your side for the invoice_reference?

Attachment: sagemap_remit_sample.csv (CSV, 3 rows)

Subject: Fwd: Vendor payment orientation & remittance-field encoding

Marissa / Jonas —

Forwarding SageWave’s bank letter + sample CSV. They confirmed ACH as primary, wires only for exceptions. They can populate "invoice_reference" with the PO (no prefix) and include a separate po_number column if we want it explicit — their default is one row per invoice.

Ask: can you quickly verify (1) whether the 64-char limit for invoice_reference is OK, (2) our UAT importer will accept one-row-per-invoice (yes/no) and (3) whether we need to request a pipe-separated list for multi-invoice payments instead? If you can do a preflight test import in UAT and confirm the mapping, we’ll schedule one ACH test import and a micro-deposit verification.

Also pinging Finance (internal payops) to confirm that for first live run we require SageWave to include the payment batch id on the header row (we can provide template).

Docs/links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PO-789 (onboarding ticket)

Thanks —
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
